detail.longDescription: With int8 and 8 CPU threads, faster-whisper skipped whole passages on my machine, with no error. Fewer threads aren't a full fix. float32 was clean. A tool checks your own transcripts. # python # whisper # machinelearning # debugging # software # coding # development # engineering # inclusive # community faster-whisper int8 dropped up to 60 s of speech. float32 didn't
